entries.이승과 저승 사이의 경계 병동. 기억을 잃은 주인공은 상담사 같은 저승사: A ward on the border between this world and the next. Guided by a Reaper who acts like a counselor, an amnesiac protagonist merges the scattered emotion orbs of the departed, helping them reclaim themselves and pass on to the afterlife.
entries.감성 병합 퍼즐과 치유 서사의 결합: Emotional merge puzzles meet a story of healing
entries.Project B는 단순 점수 경쟁보다, 감정 합성이 망자의 자아 회복과: Rather than simple score chasing, Project B ties every emotion merge directly to a departed soul's recovery of self.
entries.경계 병동 세계관: The world of the Liminal Ward
entries.이승과 저승 사이 병동을 중심 허브로 사용해 UI, 챕터, 스토리를 하나: A ward between the living world and the afterlife serves as the central hub, tying the UI, chapters and story into a single world.
entries.기쁨·슬픔·분노·공포에서 출발해 해탈·아가페까지. 단순 숫자 병합이 아닌: From Joy, Sorrow, Anger and Fear all the way to Liberation and Agape. The rules follow the logic of emotion, not just merging numbers.
entries.구슬을 합성하면 망자의 기억 조각이 열립니다. 퍼즐 진행 자체가 스토리: Merging orbs unlocks fragments of the departed's memories. Solving the puzzle is how you experience the story.
entries.합성 성공 시마다 멜로디 레이어가 추가됩니다. 플레이어의 행동이 음악을: Every successful merge adds a new melody layer. Your actions build the music as you play.
entries.감정이 쌓이고 합성되어 자아를 회복한다: Emotions build up, merge and restore the self
entries.챕터 최종 목표 감정을 완성하면 망자는 자신의 이름과 생전 감정을 기억하: Complete a chapter's final target emotion and the departed soul remembers their name and the feelings they had in life, then moves on to the afterlife.
entries.합성 점수 = 단계 × 단계 × 10점 · 연쇄 합성 보너스 = 연쇄 수: Merge score = tier × tier × 10 pts · Chain bonus = chain count × 50 pts
entries.병동에 머무는 망자들: The departed who linger in the ward
entries.각 망자는 생전의 강한 감정으로 자아가 흐려진 채 병동에 머뭅니다. 플레: Each of the departed lingers in the ward, their sense of self clouded by a powerful emotion from life. The player enters their emotional space and completes their core emotion.
entries.각 챕터는 한 명의 망자와 그 생전 감정을 중심으로 구성됩니다. 최종 감: Each chapter centers on one departed soul and the emotions they carried in life. Complete the final emotion and they reclaim their self and move on to the afterlife.
entries.경계 병동의 세계관, 핵심 개념, 망자와 사건들을 정리한 기록입니다. 분: A record of the Liminal Ward's world, key concepts, the departed and events. Use the category buttons and search box to find things fast.
entries.감정, 망자, 병동 검색: Search emotions, the departed, the ward
entries.상단에서 감정 구슬을 좌우 조준해 컨테이너에 떨어뜨립니다. 물리 기반으로: Aim emotion orbs left and right at the top and drop them into the container. They fall and collide with real physics.
entries.같은 감정 구슬 두 개가 충돌하면 상위 감정으로 자동 합성됩니다. 7단계: When two identical emotion orbs collide, they automatically merge into a higher emotion, following the 7-tier tree.
entries.합성 후 새로 생성된 구슬이 같은 구슬과 닿으면 즉시 추가 합성이 발생합: If a newly merged orb touches a matching orb, another merge triggers instantly.
entries.EP가 충전되면 정리·교체·축소 등의 특수 스킬을 사용해 위기를 돌파합니: Once EP is charged, use special skills like Tidy, Swap and Shrink to get out of a jam.
entries.끝내 전하지 못한 마음을 간직한 채 병동에 머문다. 빗소리, 편지, 흐릿: Lingers in the ward, holding on to feelings never confessed. An emotional space full of rain, letters and faded photos.
entries.이루지 못한 꿈과 반복된 실패. 무너진 무대와 꺼진 스포트라이트의 공간에: Unfulfilled dreams and repeated failure. Lost in self-denial amid a collapsed stage and dark spotlights.
entries.너무 오래 버티다 감정을 닫아버린 삶. 텅 빈 병실과 멈춘 시계, 겨울: A life that endured too long and shut its emotions away. A space of an empty hospital room, a stopped clock and a winter lake.
entries.기억을 잃은 채 병동에서 깨어난 인물. 감정 도감 90% 수집 달성 시: Awoke in the ward with no memories. Their own emotional space opens at 90% Emotion Codex completion.
entries.이유는 첫 번째 병실에 머무는 망자입니다. 생전에 누군가를 오래 그리워했: Iyu is a departed soul staying in the first room of the ward. In life, Iyu longed for someone for years but never confessed. The player merges orbs of longing and sorrow to recover Iyu's forgotten memories.
entries.준은 큰 꿈을 품었지만 실패를 반복했고, 죽음 이후에도 자신이 아무것도: Jun had big dreams but failed again and again, and even after death feels nothing was ever achieved. Merge orbs of passion, anger and ambition to help Jun remember the self that endured through failure.
entries.소아는 너무 오래 버티며 살아왔고 끝내 자신의 감정을 느끼지 못하는 상태: Soa endured for far too long and eventually lost the ability to feel. Merge orbs of apathy, cynicism and detachment to help Soa face why those emotions were buried.
entries.감정 도감 90% 수집 또는 전 챕터 클리어 시 해금됩니다. 주인공 자신: Unlocks at 90% Emotion Codex completion or after clearing every chapter. The protagonist's own room opens, revealing that helping the other departed was preparation for facing their own truth.
entries.같은 감정 구슬 두 개가 충돌하면 상위 감정으로 자동 합성됩니다. 기쁨+: When two identical emotion orbs collide, they automatically merge into a higher emotion. The logic of emotion becomes the puzzle's rules, as in Joy + Sorrow = Longing.
entries.기쁨·슬픔·분노·공포 4개의 뿌리 감정에서 출발해 해탈·아가페·모노노아와: A merge structure that starts from four root emotions (Joy, Sorrow, Anger and Fear) and leads up to transcendent emotions like Liberation, Agape and Mono no aware.
entries.감정 구슬이 컨테이너 붕괴선을 3초 이상 초과하면 스테이지 실패. 경고: If emotion orbs stay above the container's collapse line for more than 3 seconds, the stage fails. The line flashes at the warning stage and the screen shakes at the danger stage.
entries.합성 성공 시마다 멜로디 레이어가 추가됩니다. 고차 감정 생성 시 현악기: Every successful merge adds a melody layer. Higher-tier emotions bring in strings and chorus, so your actions complete the music.
entries.처음 합성한 감정은 도감에 자동 등록됩니다. 5회 발견 시 조합식이 완전: Emotions you merge for the first time are added to the Codex automatically. Discover one 5 times to fully unlock its recipe; collect them all to open the hidden chapter.
entries.경계 병동에서 상담사처럼 행동하는 저승사자. 망자를 강제로 데려가지 않고: A reaper who acts like a counselor in the Liminal Ward. Rather than taking the departed by force, she watches over them and guides them to accept their emotions on their own.
entries.기억을 잃은 채 경계 병동에서 깨어난 인물. 망자들의 감정을 정리하는 과: Awoke in the Liminal Ward with no memories. Sorting out the emotions of the departed is also a journey toward facing their own truth.
entries.끝내 전하지 못한 마음을 간직한 망자. 그리움→향수→미련→사우다지. 감정: A departed soul holding on to feelings never confessed. Longing → Nostalgia → Attachment → Saudade. Their emotional space is a rainy room full of old letters.
A departed soul burdened by unfulfilled dreams and repeated failure. Passion → Ambition → Grit → Courage. A space of collapsed stages and dark lights.
entries.감정을 닫아버린 삶을 산 망자. 무기력→냉소→달관→평온. 감정 공간은 겨: A departed soul who lived with their emotions shut away. Apathy → Cynicism → Detachment → Serenity. Their emotional space is a winter lake and a stopped clock.
entries.이승도 저승도 아닌 중간 지대. 하얀 병실, 긴 복도, 상담실, 대기실로: A middle ground that is neither the world of the living nor the afterlife. It has white rooms, long corridors, a counseling room and a waiting room, and each room connects to a departed soul's inner emotional space.
entries.자신의 죽음을 받아들이지 못한 망자들이 머무는 공간. 감정 공간이 안정화: Where the departed who cannot accept their own death linger. Souls whose emotional spaces have not stabilized wander here.
entries.감정과 기억이 정리되어 저장되는 장소. 감정 도감의 세계관적 배경으로,: Where emotions and memories are sorted and stored. The in-world basis for the Emotion Codex, where the protagonist reads other souls' records to find clues.
entries.주인공이 경계 병동에서 눈을 뜨는 순간. 자신이 왜 이곳에 있는지 알지: The moment the protagonist opens their eyes in the Liminal Ward. Not knowing why they are there, they meet the Reaper, and the story begins.
entries.챕터 1의 결말. 사우다지를 완성하며 이유는 자신의 그리움이 삶의 일부였: The ending of Chapter 1. By completing Saudade, Iyu accepts that longing was part of life and moves on to the afterlife.
entries.숨겨진 챕터에서 드러나는 사건. 다른 망자를 도운 것이 자신의 해탈을 위: An event revealed in the hidden chapter: helping the other departed was preparation for the protagonist's own liberation.
